description: For the 24 February SME-owners gathering, advance results expected about 400, but actual attendance appears only as “several tens” in a Russian-language Diez search result. That phrase has no numeric lower bound; the inclusion threshold remains unresolved.
required_followup: Find an accessible independent contemporaneous actual-turnout estimate or organizer/police count; do not substitute the advance estimate or infer at least 50.

description: The 22 February Ocnița rail-workers’ results include a qualitative “several” description but no number. Blocked railway lines/freight movement do not measure the assembled crowd, and the precise public-gathering form remains uncertain.
required_followup: Seek accessible contemporaneous local reporting, organizer information or direct evidence for turnout and assembly location.

description: The 26 February Ocnița NewsMaker search result reports another protest but no crowd estimate; the body retrieval returned a technical Cache miss. Its relationship to 22 February and the 5 January action is unresolved.
required_followup: Use a fresh independently reviewed access path if later research is needed; verify turnout and whether this was a new, resumed or continuous gathering.

description: The 23 February Democracy at Home gathering outside the Constitutional Court is reported during a government-formation dispute, with slogans directed at the acting justice minister. Exact state demands, attendance and whether the purpose was public-policy change or partisan support remain unverified.
required_followup: Review accessible contemporary coverage or audiovisual documentation for the exact slogans, demand, audience size and relationship to the Court’s proceeding.

description: None of the four candidate gatherings has a documented physical end time/date. No end is inferred from article publication, later reporting or month boundary; several exact gathering sites are also unresolved.
required_followup: Seek event-specific reports of participant departure/dissolution and precise site; leave end dates null unless directly supported.

description: Search-result excerpts cannot establish protester violence or event-specific arrests, beatings, dispersal, ignoring, killings, shootings or accommodation. A reported pledge by a Presidential Administration secretary to inform the Government does not itself establish a policy concession.
required_followup: Find direct event-specific reports for each state-response dimension; preserve unknowns absent evidence.

description: The national 23 February passenger-route action clearly disrupted service and opposed state restrictions, but the available records do not show a separate public gathering. The cited 1,500 count is vehicles, not participants.
required_followup: Only reopen as an event lead if evidence documents an associated public assembly and its turnout; do not convert route/vehicle coverage into a crowd.

description: An Ungheni rail-worker wage ultimatum appears in two search-only reports, but neither result documents a public gathering or gives the action’s exact date. It is preserved as a non-candidate lead rather than assumed to be a protest.
required_followup: Reassess only if an accessible contemporary source documents a public assembly and its date/attendance.

description: NewsMaker’s February results reference separate December Basarabeasca and January Ocnița wage actions; the January dossier itself treats Basarabeasca as a possible prior-month continuation and Ocnița as distinct. No evidence establishes that the February 22 and 26 gatherings are one continuous or nationally coordinated action, so they remain separate candidates and there is no February continuation record.
required_followup: Compare any later accessible participant/organizer/continuity evidence with the January dossier; preserve the separate local dates absent proof of continuity.

description: All 31 source cards are search-only. Four actual article-body attempts produced technical no-body results: Diez Romanian S001 Internal Error, Realitatea S011 Cache miss, NewsMaker S012 Cache miss and Diez Russian S007 Cache miss. The attempts yielded no usable article text. Separate prerequisite failures/no-request records are preserved in access_receipts and are not counted as article-body outcomes.
required_followup: If later work pursues these stories, use new exact-URL receipt/manual-review/readback/hash and immediate corpus-check gates for each attempt; do not repeat an attempt solely to reconstruct unavailable output.

description: The first pass logged broad, weekly/date-specific, sector and publisher-targeted searches in Romanian, Russian and English. It did not systematically cover Gagauz-language sources, local/regional newspaper archives, every publisher or all official records. Web results have uneven coverage and no reliable total-result universe.
required_followup: A later pass can add Gagauz and local/regional archive searches plus systematic source follow-up; treat first-pass findings as non-exhaustive.

description: Some surfaced records are duplicate or parallel-language content rather than independent confirmation: Noi.md S003 attributes the SME story to Diez; Diez Russian S007 is a parallel edition; NewsMaker Russian S028 parallels its Romanian report; Moldovenii S029 is a second host variant of S010; and Stiri.md S020 attributes its report to Publika.
required_followup: Check written origin and story identity before treating repeated results as independent support.

description: The latest official Mass Mobilization baseline/universe and the complete original Coding Procedure remain unverified. These local proposals are not approved official events.
required_followup: Coordinator resolves baseline and procedure gates; candidates remain local and pending review.
